mapper.select: SELECT id, mcp_id, mcp_name, mcp_type, mcp_param, mcp_secret, mcp_desc, mcp_timeout, mcp_from, create_time, update_time FROM ai_mcp WHERE mcp_id = #{mcpId}

SELECT id, mcp_id, mcp_name, mcp_type, mcp_param, mcp_secret, mcp_desc, mcp_timeout, mcp_from, create_time, update_time FROM ai_mcp WHERE mcp_id IN
#{id}
SELECT id, mcp_id, mcp_name, mcp_type, mcp_param, mcp_secret, mcp_desc, mcp_timeout, mcp_from, create_time, update_time FROM ai_mcp WHERE mcp_from = #{userId}

SELECT id, mcp_id, mcp_name, mcp_type, mcp_param, mcp_secret, mcp_desc, mcp_timeout, mcp_from, create_time, update_time FROM ai_mcp
AND ( mcp_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR mcp_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR mcp_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR mcp_desc LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY update_time DESC, id DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ai_mcp
AND ( mcp_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR mcp_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR mcp_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR mcp_desc LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_mcp (mcp_id, mcp_name, mcp_type, mcp_param, mcp_secret, mcp_desc, mcp_timeout, mcp_from) VALUES (#{mcpId}, #{mcpName}, #{mcpType}, #{mcpParam}, #{mcpSecret}, #{mcpDesc}, #{mcpTimeout}, #{mcpFrom})
